content_sections.heading: GMCH Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) and 1 for Project Technical Support III.

content_sections.heading: GMCH Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): First class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degree in Microbiology/Biochemistry, Genetics/Immunology. Desirable: research experience preferably in human blood sample processing (performing rt-PCR). Project Technical support III: Minimum second class or equivalent CGPA with four-year Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy (B. Pharm) /Nursing (B.Sc. Nursing) course with Basic computer course certificate. Desirable: research experience in Clinical trials (drug handling) and proficiency in MS Office and data entry.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the GMCH Recruitment 2026 is 20th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the GMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I and Project Technical support -III in the Government Medical College & Hospital (GMCH) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For the Project Research Scientist-I position, candidates must possess a First class Post Graduate Degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or Immunology. Integrated PG degrees are also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Project Research Scientist-I and Project Technical support -III positions is 35 years. Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Technical support - III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical support - III post will receive a salary of @28000/- + 20% HRA (5600/-) which amounts to Rs. 33,600/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for GMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the GMCH Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to submit hard copies of their applications along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the GMCH Recruitment 2026 involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: Completed application forms should be sent to the Project Room (Ms. Leena), Pediatric office, Deptt. of Pediatrics, Block D, Level 4, GMCH, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to confirm this in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the project for which these positions are being recruited?
faq.answer: These positions are for an ICMR funded project titled 'EFFICACY IN SCRUB TYPHUS OF COMBINATION THERAPY IN CHILDREN VERSUS AZITHROMYCIN OR DOXYCYCLINE MONOTHERAPY: A DOUBLE-BLIND RANDOMIZED CONTROL TRIAL (ESCHAR TRIAL)' at GMCH-32, Chandigarh.
